title: Learning and generating differ
summary: Training changes a model using examples. Generation uses an already prepared model to produce an output. Asking a question is not the same operation as retraining all its weights.
introduction: Training changes a model using examples. Generation uses an already prepared model to produce an output. Asking a question is not the same operation as retraining all its weights. We will use a small example so you can follow each step.
learningObjectives: Use the example to answer a practice question

blocks.title: Learning and generating differ

blocks.text: These are different stages with different costs and purposes. A service may have its own data policies, so read those before sharing information.
